## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8af37ee5bcc544739d6c64666561d6e34fd1d438`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md, skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the gate the ratchet rows enforce, read as one change), packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/app.test.ts, ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexEntry-27525.test.tsx, .changeset/27609-skills-report-index-nav.md

Read: the PR body, the six-file diff (`origin/main...8af37ee5`, 35+/8-), card #27609 with triage 6500503311 and claim 6513377101, PR #27566 (`bf658d1b8`) in full, the dev report at /mnt/project-files/skills-lane-seat2/report-27609.json, and the head's check-runs. Nothing built or run; token readings are `wc -c` by hand under the script's own stated convention.

### ① Derived judgments

Each claim the PR teaches, against the code #27566 shipped on `main`:

1. `reportName` optional — TRUE. `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:687-693`: `reportName: z.string().optional().describe('Target report name. Omit it and the entry opens the app's report index (the reports the app ships that the member may open) instead of one report.')`. The variant TSDoc (`:670-682`) states the two targets and that the console draws an index entry only where navigation declares one. Pinned by `app.test.ts` ("accepts a report item without reportName as the app report index entry": parses on the variant, through the union, inside `AppSchema`, and holds no `reportName` after parse).
2. No `reportName` routes to APP/reports — TRUE. `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx:1010-1013` `resolveHref` `case 'report'`: `item.reportName ? BASE/report/NAME : BASE/reports`. The active-row election reads the same answer (sidebar test (c)).
3. The injected "All reports" row is gone — TRUE. `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` deletes the `{!isStudioApp && (...)}` block that drew `Link to=BASE/reports` with `data-testid="sidebar-report-index"`, and the replacing comment says the sidebar injects no index row of its own. `UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexEntry-27525.test.tsx` (a): no "All reports" link, no `/apps/crm/reports` href, no `sidebar-report-index` when navigation declares none.
4. SKILL.md row `reportName?`, "A report; no `reportName` = the app's report index" — accurate; the `?` notation matches the `viewName?` / `recordId?` convention already in the table.
5. navigation.md example `{ id: 'nav_reports', type: 'report', label: 'Reports', icon: 'library' }` with the comment "the console adds none itself" — accurate. A labelled entry shows its label (test (b) second case: `label: 'Reports'` renders a link named "Reports" to `/apps/crm/reports`, and no "All reports" link). `library` is a real lucide icon (`lucide-react@1.43.0`, the version `ui/packages/layout` pins, ships `icons/library.mjs`), resolved by `resolveIcon` in `NavigationRenderer.tsx:1701`. The `os:check` block type-checks against the spec as it is on `main` (the input union carries `z.input` of `ReportNavItemSchema`, whose `reportName` is optional); the dev reports `check:skill-examples` green at 274 examples, not re-run here.
6. app-composition.md route row `{type:'report'}` → `/reports`, "none unless navigation declares it" — accurate (item 2 and 3). The renderer note is renderer-side, which is what the guide says it owns.
7. Skills sweep on the head (`git grep` over `skills/**`, all packages, evals included, for "All reports", "report index", "injected", "reportName", `'report'`): no page claims an injected row; the only `reportName` mentions are the three edited files; no other skill teaches a report nav item. Nothing #27566 made false was missed. `packages/skills` is a wipe-and-copy of `skills/**` into `dist/` at build, so the published catalog carries the edit with no second copy to update.
8. Changeset `@objectstack/skills` patch (`packages/skills/package.json` names that package), `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, Before/Now state the same facts as the diff and name eval case 10. Consistent with the PR body.
9. The SKILL.md hunk is one line (`:171`); `:109-121` (#27354's section) is untouched.

Ratchet, re-measured by hand under the script's convention (ceil(utf8 bytes / 4); a stamped SKILL.md first subtracts its 20-byte `  version: "18.2.0"` line):

| File | main | head | ceiling on head |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | 15378 b − 20 → 3840 | 15412 b − 20 → 3848 | 3851, unchanged |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` | 9081 b → 2271 | 9092 b → 2273 | 2273, unchanged |
| `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md` | 4311 b → 1078 | 4312 b → 1078 | 1079, unchanged |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` | 8034 b → 2009 | 8432 b → 2108 | 2009 → 2108 |

Every reading matches the PR body and the dev report. The raised row's comment pins the measured bytes (`== ceil(8432 / 4)`) and quotes the ruling as the neighbouring rows do, verbatim: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (2026-10-27, tap A). The file's cases share no sentence, so "no duplicate to cut" holds.

The cuts lost no fact. navigation.md: the old `filters` comment's four facts (bare data surface at `/:objectName/data`, objectui ADR-0055, removable URL chips, anchored to the URL not a saved view, do not author a view for it) all stand in the Run Modes table and decision rule the new comment points at (`:59-76`). app-composition.md: the dropped parenthetical (`objectName`, `pageName`, `dashboardName`, `reportName`, `url`, `componentRef`) is the route table's first column, row for row.

Eval case 10. The prompt ("Give the crm app a Reports entry listing every report it ships") is a fair ask for the index form and matches the navigation.md example; `must_contain: ["type: 'report'"]` is right. But `must_not_contain: ["reportName"]` does NOT reward the right answer: the skill teaches the form as "no `reportName` = the app's report index" (SKILL.md `:171`, navigation.md `:37`), so an agent that follows the skill and says why it omits the key spells `reportName` and fails, while an answer that omits it silently passes. The case's own `expected_output` spells the forbidden string ("with no `reportName`"), the self-disagreement this file was reworded to remove in #26790 (cases 5 and 8) and that #26814 and #27455 fixed in the formula and platform evals. The file's precedent for an absent-key assertion is the integrations-declared row (`clientSecret` → `clientSecret:`, "so a correct answer naming the absent field still passes"). Must-fix 1.

### ② Semver level

`@objectstack/skills` patch; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and the changeset. Prose in the published catalog only; no schema, key or behaviour moves. The level and the declarations agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- File surface widened to `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md`: recorded in the claim (6513377101) as an amendment, and the file carried the same defect (named route only). Answered.
- Ratchet row raised for the eval file (+99) under the standing ruling: the ruling is quoted verbatim, the value pinned at the measurement, the doc files paid inside their ceilings. Answered; note that must-fix 1 adds one byte to the eval file (8433 → 2109), so the row and its comment move with it, or a byte is cut elsewhere in the file.
- Four gate families NOT MEASURED (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`): all need a whole-tree `dist/` and none reads `skills/**` or the ratchet script. Accepted as reported; CI is the record.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` red once (`spec-symbol-ledger-plugin-detail-7265.test.ts`), green alone on this head and on `main` and on the full rerun: unrelated to the diff. Accepted.
- Dev ran at opus with the proactive low-headroom exit; this CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review is the compensation named in the claim.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no other-author note owed.
- CI at review time (53 check-runs on `8af37ee5`): Dogfood Regression Gate, Auto Label and Live E2E UI success; Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, UI Published Artifacts, Dogfood Regression Gate matrix and Build Docs skipped; Test UI 1-16, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build and E2E UI and Test Core 1-3 in progress. Not all green yet; the lane seat reads the final state before landing.

### ④ Design judgment

The three governed pages now teach what the spec and console on `main` do: `reportName` optional, absence = the app's report index at `/reports`, no injected row. Each sentence was checked against the cited code (①.1-3) and the index form is shown beside the named form in both the table and the example, as the card asks, inside each file's ceiling. app-composition.md's reminder "Emit the chosen type's target field" now has one row with no target field; the table row directly above it covers that case, so it reads correctly, noted and not a defect. The one thing that does not hold is the eval: the case built to check that an agent learned the index form fails the agent that explains it in the skill's own words (①, must-fix 1). The skill's teaching is right; its eval rewards the wrong behaviour.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Must-fix:
1. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` case 10: narrow `must_not_contain` from `"reportName"` to `"reportName:"` (the key written with a value), so an answer that names the absent key passes and one that writes it fails; the `expected_output` then no longer spells its own forbidden string. Re-measure the file and move the ratchet row and its `== ceil(N / 4)` comment to the new byte count under the same ruling (8433 bytes → 2109 if nothing else changes), or cut one byte in the file to hold 8432.

Should-fix: none.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8400c22560ad4c11be9e5fef4689fe2694c78dc9`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md, skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the gate the ratchet rows enforce, read as one change), packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/app.test.ts, ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexEntry-27525.test.tsx, .changeset/27609-skills-report-index-nav.md

Delta review by the same reviewer of the commit that answers must-fix 1 of the record on `8af37ee5` (comment 6514098359). Read: `git diff 8af37ee5..8400c225` (one commit, `8400c2256` "fix(skills): eval case 10 refuses `reportName:` written, not the word"; one file, 2+/2−), the whole diff `origin/main...8400c225` (still 6 files, 35+/8−, identical to the reviewed head outside the two lines below), the eval file re-measured by hand, the ratchet row on the new head, and the head's check-runs. Nothing built or run. The findings on `8af37ee5` that the delta does not touch carry forward unchanged and are restated in brief.

### ① Derived judgments

The delta, in full:

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` case 10 `must_not_contain`: `"reportName"` → `"reportName:"`. Closes must-fix 1: an answer that writes the key with a value (`reportName: 'x'`) fails; an answer that names the absent key in the skill's own words ("no `reportName`") passes; and the case's `expected_output` ("`{ type: 'report' }` with no `reportName` is the app's report index …") no longer spells its own forbidden string (checked: the forbidden string does not occur in `expected_output`; the `must_contain` string `type: 'report'` does). This is the integrations-declared precedent (`clientSecret` → `clientSecret:`) applied as the record asked.
2. Case 10 prompt: "listing every report it ships" → "listing all reports it ships". Same ask, same meaning: one navigation entry that opens the app's full report list, which only the index form gives; "all reports" is also the console's own name for the index page, so the wording still points at the index without naming the form or the key. Fair, and it rewards the right answer: the index form passes, a named `reportName:` fails, and an explanation of the omission passes.
3. Nothing else changed between the two heads. The other five files are byte-identical to `8af37ee5`; the file is valid JSON with 10 cases.

Ratchet, re-measured by hand (ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)): "every report" → "all reports" is −1 byte and the colon is +1, so the file is 8432 bytes → 2108 on the new head, as on the reviewed head. The ratchet row (`:1132`, 2108) and its comment (`:1131`, `== ceil(8432 / 4)`) are untouched and still true; the ruling quote is as before. The three doc files did not move (SKILL.md 3848 ≤ 3851, navigation.md 2273 == 2273, app-composition.md 1078 ≤ 1079).

Carried forward from `8af37ee5` (unchanged by the delta): every claim the three pages teach holds against the code #27566 shipped on `main` (`reportName` optional at `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:687-693`; `resolveHref` answers `BASE/reports` for an absent name at `NavigationRenderer.tsx:1010-1013`; the injected "All reports" block is deleted from `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` and the sidebar test pins no row when navigation declares none, and a `label: 'Reports'` entry rendering as "Reports" → `/apps/crm/reports`; `library` is a lucide-react 1.43.0 icon); the skills sweep finds nothing #27566 made false; the two doc cuts lost no fact; the SKILL.md hunk is `:171` only; the changeset is consistent with the body.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `@objectstack/skills` patch; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and the changeset. The delta is two strings in an eval fixture.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The thread reports local skill gates all exit 0 on the new head; not re-run here, CI is the record.
- The ratchet row did not need to move because the prompt gave back the byte the colon cost; the body's token table (2108, 8432 bytes) stays accurate.
- File-surface widening, the ratchet raise under the standing ruling, the four dist-dependent NOT MEASURED gate families, the once-red vitest run and the opus-with-fable-review compensation: answered on `8af37ee5`, unchanged.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no other-author note owed. `mergeable_state: clean`.
- CI on `8400c225`: 57 check-runs, all completed, none failed. Success: Test Core (1/8, 2/8, 3/8 and the roll-up), Test UI 1-16 and the roll-up, Build and E2E UI, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build UI Deps, Build Core, Plan Test Core shards, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, filter, Auto Label, Lint and Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check (debt ledger, source gates, workspace, consumer gates), Lint (docs and code guards, ESLint, scoped slot lookup and corpus, scoped tooling self-tests, scoped query-options erasure, PM dispatch-gates, CI release and engine gates, repo and tooling gates), Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard. Skipped by design: UI Published Artifacts, Build Docs, Dogfood Verify CLI, Dogfood Regression Gate matrix, Temporal Conformance, 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Schedule gate, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in).

### ④ Design judgment

The one defect the first record found is gone: the eval that checks an agent learned the index form now passes the agent that explains it in the skill's own words and fails the one that writes a `reportName:`, and the case agrees with its own assertions. The teaching on the three governed pages was already right and is untouched. The skill files hold against the card's eval prompt and the spec on `main`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：技能里的 `report` 导航项改为 `reportName` 可选：不写 `reportName` 就是应用的报表索引页（`APP/reports`），控制台自己不再加。`objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 改了报表那一行，`rules/navigation.md` 加了一条索引项示例，`objectui/guides/app-composition.md` 的路由表加了一行，并加了一条 eval（第 10 条）。6 个文件 +35/−8，含 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset，以及一条 token 棘轮行（eval 文件 2009 → 2108）。
- 为什么改：PR #27566 之后，控制台不再自动注入「All reports」行，只有导航里声明了索引项的应用才有报表索引；技能只教带名字的报表项，照着写的应用就没有报表入口。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字和一条 eval，不改 spec 或控制台行为。三个文档文件靠删重复句留在上限内；棘轮行按「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」逐字引用并按实测钉住。revert 即回滚。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:171`，再看 `rules/navigation.md:38` 和 `objectui/guides/app-composition.md:22`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exit 0；`git grep -n "reportName?" -- skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 命中第 171 行。
- 需要你做的：`skills/**` 是受管面，登记册判 Tier H，请批准本 PR（契约复核 FAIL 6514098359 → 修复后差量 PASS 见上一条记录，`Head-sha: 8400c22560ad4c11be9e5fef4689fe2694c78dc9`）。

席位意见：ACCEPT。首轮契约复核所教内容全部属实，但判了一条 must-fix：eval 第 10 条的 `must_not_contain: ["reportName"]` 会让如实解释「不写 reportName」的正确答案判错。已收窄为 `"reportName:"`，差量复核 PASS，没有 should-fix。CI 全绿。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27609`, six files (+35/−8): `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` (one row, `:171`), `rules/navigation.md`, `evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` (case 10), `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md` (route row, claim-amended in), `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (one row), and a `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset. Governed `skills/**`: `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27903` reads Tier H (人合).
- **前提实测:** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:687-693` makes `reportName` optional and says omitting it opens the report index; `NavigationRenderer.tsx` `resolveHref` routes no `reportName` to `BASE/reports`; `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` no longer injects the "All reports" row, pinned by `UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexEntry-27525.test.tsx` (review ①).
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `8400c22560ad4c11be9e5fef4689fe2694c78dc9`: 57 check-runs, all completed, 0 failed (every Test Core / Test UI shard, Build & E2E UI, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard success; the rest skipped by design); `mergeable_state` clean.
- **接受的偏差:** file surface widened to `objectui/guides/app-composition.md` (same defect, recorded in claim 6513377101); one ratchet row raised (eval file 2009 → 2108) under the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」, quoted verbatim and pinned at the measurement; four dist-dependent gates NOT MEASURED locally (dts-closure, dual-build-cjs-loads, lean-entry-closure, sourcemap-no-sources-content), covered by CI. Token readings: SKILL.md 3848/3851, navigation.md 2273/2273, app-composition.md 1078/1079.
- **范围外去向:** none. #27354 (queued) later edits `SKILL.md:109-121`, a different section; it is released once this lands.
- **落地条款:** Tier H: a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval, then the seat lands it under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
